summary: Customer asks whether fiber optic products can measure line pressure and flow rate of a slurry in a transfer pipe, and provide early warning of pipe blockage.

facts_stated.text: Need to know line pressure and flow rate of a slurry in a transfer pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We need to know the line pressure and the flow rate of a slurry in our transfer pipe

facts_stated.text: Want early warning when the pipe starts to block.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: we want an early warning when the pipe starts to block

facts_stated.text: Ask whether fiber optic products can help.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Could your fiber optic products help with this?

targets.enquiry_quote: early warning when the pipe starts to block

customer_premises.claim: Fiber optic products can measure line pressure, flow rate, and provide early warning of pipe blockage.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Could your fiber optic products help with this?

customer_premises.claim: Early warning of pipe blockage is achievable.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: we want an early warning when the pipe starts to block

customer_premises.claim: A slurry in a transfer pipe can be monitored with fiber optic products.
